people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The house of Israel called its name “Manna”, and it was like coriander seed, white; and its taste was like wafers with honey.
translations.bsb: Now the house of Israel called the bread manna. It was white like coriander seed and tasted like wafers made with honey.
translations.kjv: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.
translations.asv: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.
